The gradle-wrapper.jar file must be added here before building.

OPTION 1 — Android Studio (easiest):
  Open the project in Android Studio. It will automatically detect the missing
  wrapper jar and offer to generate it. Click "OK" when prompted.

OPTION 2 — Command line (if you have Gradle installed):
  cd <project-root>
  gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.4

OPTION 3 — Download manually:
  Download gradle-wrapper.jar from:
  https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/v8.4.0/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
  Place it in: gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

This is a standard Android project requirement. The jar is not included in
version control by some teams, but Android Studio always handles it automatically.
